headline: Tunisia 2027 Budget Sees Debt at 85% of GDP Amid $4.9 Billion Gap
summary: Tunisia's 2027 budget plan forecasts public debt at 85% of GDP with an economic growth target of 3.1%, leaving a $4.9 billion borrowing gap.
why: Tunisia's debt trajectory and deficit financing requirements are closely scrutinized by sovereign bondholders and international financial institutions amid tight financing conditions.

impacts.name: Tunisia
impacts.why: The budget targets 3.1% economic growth while projecting debt at 85% of GDP and a $4.9 billion financing gap.
